# `monthname`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
monthname(date)
```

Returns the three-letter abbreviated month name from the given date.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- monthname, example 1
> SELECT monthname('2008-02-20');

```
